name: Klickkk : Click to Chat
author: Klickkk Digital

sections.description:
Klickkk : Click to Chat adds a floating chat button that opens a one-tap conversation with your WhatsApp number, complete with a customizable greeting bubble. Everything runs from your own site — no external scripts are loaded and no visitor data is collected or sent anywhere.

Features

  • One-tap chat link with a prefilled message.
  • Independent size, position, and offset controls for desktop and mobile.
  • Greeting bubble with its own heading and message, hover-to-reveal option, and per-device auto-hide timer.
  • Right-to-left text layout support for the greeting bubble, set independently per device.
  • Independent desktop and mobile visibility toggles for both the button and the greeting.
  • Target specific WordPress page types, individual posts/pages, and WooCommerce routes (shop, product, cart, checkout, account).
  • Live, interactive settings preview — see your changes before saving.
  • No external JavaScript dependencies, no tracking, no data collection.

Unlike a site-wide chat button with a single visibility switch, Klickkk : Click to Chat includes native WordPress content targeting, WooCommerce route controls, and independent desktop and mobile presentation settings.

Development

All PHP, JavaScript, and CSS source code is included in the distributed plugin. The assets are human-readable and are loaded directly by WordPress; no build tools or compilation steps are required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install its ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Klickkk : Click to Chat.
  3. Open Settings > Click to Chat, enter your full WhatsApp number, and save.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send any data to an external server?

No. The only external destination involved is wa.me, and only when a visitor actively clicks the chat button — that is a normal outbound link, not something the plugin calls on its own.

Can I show the button only on specific pages?

Yes. Under Visibility, choose “Selected pages” to restrict the button to specific page types (home, posts, pages, archives, WooCommerce routes, etc.) and/or specific individual pages.

Can the greeting bubble look different on desktop and mobile?

Yes. Size, offsets, hover-to-reveal, auto-hide delay, and right-to-left layout can all be set independently for desktop and mobile.
